responsibility: This target header customizes the SPARC configuration for the VxWorks runtime. It emits VxWorks-specific preprocessor builtins, delegates option overrides and CPP/link/startfile/endfile/library/profiling specs to shared VxWorks macros, disables PC-relative EH data assumptions unsuitable for VxWorks PIC, and enables static/probing stack checks, integrating the generic SPARC backend with VxWorks toolchain and runtime conventions.
